name: Data Quality Completeness
description: Validates all required market data, reference data, and trade data is present across the entity. Flags gaps in instrument codes, missing curve pillars, stale fixings, and orphaned trades. Runs early so downstream analytics have a clean data baseline.

name: System Health
description: Monitors service availability, NATS message latency, database connection pool saturation, and per-service error rates. Produces a traffic-light dashboard: green (all healthy), amber (degraded), red (down). Alerts on sustained error-rate spikes above 5%.

name: Audit Trail Summary
description: Daily summary of all create, update, and delete operations across all domain entities for the entity. Broken down by service, actor, and change reason category. Supports SOX and SOC 2 compliance requirements for change logging.

name: SA-CCR Exposure
description: Standardised Approach for Counterparty Credit Risk: computes Exposure-at-Default (EAD), Replacement Cost (RC), and Potential Future Exposure (PFE) per netting set under Basel III/IV supervisory rules. Required for Risk-Weighted Asset (RWA) and leverage ratio calculations. Replaces the legacy Current Exposure Method (CEM).

name: Leverage Ratio
description: Computes the Basel III leverage ratio: Tier 1 capital divided by total exposure measure (on- and off-balance sheet, derivatives, SFTs). Alerts if the ratio approaches the 3% minimum threshold. Required for all regulated entities under CRR/Basel III pillar 2.

name: FRTB SA Capital
description: Fundamental Review of the Trading Book — Standardised Approach: computes market risk capital using supervisory-prescribed sensitivity-based method (SBM) across delta, vega, and curvature risk for all risk classes (GIRR, CSR, FX, EQ, CMDTY). Floor model and fallback for desks not approved for IMA.

name: Liquidity Coverage
description: Liquidity Coverage Ratio (LCR): High-Quality Liquid Assets divided by net cash outflows over a 30-day stress horizon. Flags when HQLA buffer drops below 100% minimum. Required under Basel III for all regulated deposit-taking and investment firms.

name: Large Exposures
description: Monitors single-counterparty exposure concentration against the 25% of Tier 1 capital regulatory limit. Aggregates across all netting sets, SFTs, and indirect exposures for each legal entity counterparty. Produces breach alerts and a top-20 concentration report.

name: MIFID II Transaction Reporting
description: Trade transparency reporting under MIFID II / MIFIR Article 26. Produces transaction reports for submission to the FCA Approved Reporting Mechanism (ARM). Covers all financial instruments traded on a UK/EEA trading venue. UK entities only.

name: CFTC Swap Data Reporting
description: Swap transaction reporting under CFTC Part 43/45 rules. Produces real-time public and regulatory reports for all swap transactions to a registered Swap Data Repository (SDR). Covers all CFTC-jurisdiction swaps. US entities only.

name: HKMA Trade Repository
description: OTC derivatives transaction reporting under HKMA Securities and Futures (OTC Derivative Transactions — Reporting and Record Keeping Obligations) Rules. Reports to the HKTR via the DTCC GTR. HK entities only.

name: Group Consolidated Exposure
description: Aggregate exposure across all subsidiaries by asset class, currency, and counterparty. Eliminates intercompany positions per IFRS 10 consolidation rules. Provides the single group-wide risk view for the board and regulators. Holding company only.

name: Board Risk Dashboard
description: One-page executive summary for the board risk committee: group VaR (99% 1-day), total exposure by asset class, consolidated P&L, capital ratios (CET1, leverage, LCR), top 10 counterparty exposures, and month-on-month trend arrows. Holding company only.

name: Cross-Entity Counterparty Concentration
description: Aggregates single-name counterparty exposure across all legal entities in the group. Flags names exceeding 25% of consolidated Tier 1 capital. Identifies hidden concentration where individual subsidiary exposures appear within limits but group aggregate breaches the threshold. Holding company only.

name: Intercompany Exposure Matrix
description: Matrix of exposures between all group entities for consolidation elimination. Identifies circular funding, transfer pricing mismatches, and netting inefficiencies across the group. Monthly cadence (not daily — intercompany positions churn slowly). Holding company only.

name: Model Calibration
description: Calibrates interest rate, FX, and volatility models (LGM, Hull-White, SABR, Black-Scholes) to live market data. Outputs calibrated parameters and fit quality metrics (RMSE). Must run before exposure simulation, XVA, and sensitivity analytics that depend on calibrated model parameters.

name: Yield Curves
description: Bootstraps discount and projection yield curves from market instruments (deposits, FRAs, swaps, OIS, bonds). Outputs the full term structure of interest rates used by all pricing engines. Essential prerequisite for NPV, sensitivity, and Monte Carlo exposure analytics.

name: FX Spot Rates
description: Loads and validates FX spot rates for all active currency pairs from market data feeds. Provides consistent FX conversion for multi-currency portfolio valuation, sensitivities, and regulatory capital calculations that require base-currency aggregation.

name: Volatility Surfaces
description: Constructs implied volatility surfaces for interest rates, FX, and equity from market option quotes. Applies smile interpolation (SVI, SABR) and arbitrage-free calibration. Required for options pricing, vega sensitivities, stressed VaR, and FRTB vega capital.

name: Credit Curves
description: Bootstraps CDS-implied survival probability curves and hazard rate curves for each counterparty and entity. Calibrates credit models (Jarrow-Turnbull, Hull-White credit) to market spreads. Prerequisite for CVA, DVA, FVA, and regulatory SA-CVA capital computations.

name: NPV
description: Full mark-to-market portfolio valuation producing present values for all active trades. Applies validated yield curves and FX rates. Provides the daily P&L baseline, feeds downstream sensitivities, and serves as the reference for risk-neutral pricing across all asset classes.

name: Cashflows
description: Projects all future contractual cashflows across the portfolio: fixed, floating, contingent, and collateral flows. Used for liquidity risk, funding cost estimation, hedge effectiveness testing, and IFRS 9 / IFRS 7 cashflow disclosure.

name: Delta and Gamma
description: Computes first-order (delta) and second-order (gamma) price sensitivities to interest rates, FX, and credit spreads using bump-and-revalue. Produces risk ladder reports by tenor bucket and currency. Feeds hedging, P&L attribution, and FRTB sensitivity-based method capital.

name: Vega
description: Computes first-order sensitivity of portfolio value to implied volatility across all relevant expiry and strike dimensions. Aggregated by asset class, risk factor, and tenor. Required for volatility hedging and FRTB SBM vega capital.

name: Bucketed DV01
description: Key-rate DV01 (dollar value of one basis point) decomposition across standardised tenor buckets (1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 2Y, 5Y, 10Y, 20Y, 30Y). Provides a granular interest rate risk profile per currency, netting set, and book. Core input to duration management and FRTB delta capital.

name: Exposure
description: Monte Carlo simulation of future exposure profiles (EE, PFE, EPE, ENE) at the netting-set level using risk-factor simulation. Drives CVA/DVA valuation, regulatory capital under SA-CCR, and internal credit limits. Computationally intensive; uses queue concurrency to serialise with other long-running reports.

name: CVA/DVA/FVA
description: Composite report computing all three valuation adjustments: Credit VA (counterparty default risk), Debit VA (own default risk), and Funding VA (uncollateralised funding cost). Uses exposure profiles from the Exposure report and credit curves from Credit Curves. Essential for IFRS 13 fair value.

name: Stressed VaR
description: VaR computed over a stressed historical window (2008 financial crisis or COVID-2020) at 99% confidence, 10-day holding period. Required as a capital add-on under Basel 2.5 IMA. Uses full revaluation for non-linear exposures.

name: P&L Attribution
description: Daily decomposition of P&L into risk-factor components: delta, gamma, vega, theta, carry, and unexplained residual. Required for FRTB IMA back-testing and P&L attribution test (PLAT) compliance. Compares hypothetical P&L against actual P&L to validate model quality.

name: Intraday Risk Monitor
description: Real-time risk snapshot updated every 30 minutes during trading hours. Displays key risk metrics: PV, delta ladder, top 10 P&L movers, VaR estimate, and limit-utilisation gauges. Uses queue concurrency to serialise updates. Provides traders and desk heads with continuous risk visibility between end-of-day analytic runs.

name: Headline Position
description: Displays the most important Greeks across the entire deal set for a book or portfolio. The primary real-time risk overview report for traders and risk managers. Configurable measures (PV, Daily P&L, MTD P&L, YTD P&L, Delta P&L) and aggregation dimensions (Book, Portfolio, Currency Pair, Greek, Unit Hedge).

name: Headline Position (EOD)
description: The headline Greeks at the close: the same set the intraday definition carries, priced from the day's authorised end of day cut so the figures are authoritative and reproducible. The market risk function signs off on this one, and a later run of the intraday definition never replaces it.

name: Spot Greeks
description: P&L and Delta at a grid of spot shift levels, answering what happens to the book if spot moves by a given percentage. The intraday definition reads the live cut, so a desk questions its directional risk while the day is still moving.

name: Spot Greeks (EOD)
description: The spot shift grid at the close, priced from the day's authorised end of day cut. Market risk reads it as the authoritative statement of directional risk where the intraday definition states an indicative one.

name: Triple Vol Spot Ladder
description: Vega, Rega and Sega across every curve tenor at each spot shift level, so a desk reads vol and skew risk against a moving spot in one table. The intraday definition reads the live cut.

name: Triple Vol Spot Ladder (EOD)
description: The triple vol spot ladder at the close, priced from the day's authorised end of day cut. It is the vol risk statement of record; the intraday definition is the view taken between closes.

name: Spot Ladder
description: The full forward curve of a currency pair, every tenor's outright rate, read from the live cut rather than from a valuation. A desk asks for it while quoting and hedging at a named tenor, so it holds a schedule and fires only when the definition is activated.

name: Spike Map
description: Per currency pair, the concentration of option notional or theoretical value against expiry date and spot level, so a desk sees where barrier and digital risk piles up across time and spot. Read from the live cut, on demand.

name: Strike Map
description: The same concentration view as the spike map, bucketed by option strike rather than expiry, so a desk reads notional across strike space at each tenor. Read from the live cut, on demand.

name: Option Map
description: The traditional option map, bucketed by delta, shown beside the strike view, so one table states where notional sits across both delta and strike. Read from the live cut, on demand.

name: Intraday Change
description: How the market data and the risk of a book or portfolio have moved since a configurable reference time, so a desk reads intraday P&L attribution without waiting for the end of day explain run. Priced from the live cut.

name: Trades Since Last In
description: Every trade booked since a stated date and time, so a desk reviews its morning activity and sees what a colleague added to a shared book. Read from the live cut, on demand.
